title: app-crm: declare the Pipeline dashboard's audience gate (`requiredPermissions` on `pipeline_dashboard` and `nav_pipeline_dashboard`), so a member who cannot read its data is not offered it
body:
domain:ui#2 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CY2n1JmZZKrHgtp9jC

Filing gate: ② a wrong state offered to the user. Filed by the seat on the maintainer's ruling 6508997538 on #27491, item 5: 「C runs beside A, not instead: `domain:ui#2` files one S card in the app lane」. ⛔ Not paired with #27491's PR.

## Business reason

Who: a CRM member with no sales permission set. What happens today: the CRM landing says "Nothing in CRM is available to you yet", but the sidebar still offers **Analytics → Pipeline**. Clicking it opens a dashboard every tile of which the server refuses (all six widgets read `opportunity_metrics`). Once #27491 lands, that member gets a no-access panel instead of a blank canvas. The app still offers them a page they cannot use.

## Mechanism (read at `origin/main`)

- `examples/app-crm/src/dashboards/pipeline.dashboard.ts`: `pipeline_dashboard` declares no `requiredPermissions`.
- `examples/app-crm/src/apps/crm.app.ts` L33: `{ id: 'nav_pipeline_dashboard', type: 'dashboard', dashboardName: 'pipeline_dashboard', … }` declares none either.
- A dashboard's `requiredPermissions` (ADR-0066, #22611 / #22639) is enforced by the server (`packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts`, `audience-permission` arm: not listed, refused by name). The nav item guard applies `requiredPermissions` too.
- `navObjectReadGate.ts` prunes only `type: 'object'` nav entries, which is why the landing and the sidebar disagree.
- ⚠ The CRM permission sets (`examples/app-crm/src/security/sales-positions.ts`: `sales_rep`, `sales_manager`, `finance_approver`, `crm_sales_user`) declare object bits only, with no capability. So the gate needs a capability that a sales set actually GRANTS. The implementer either adds one to the set(s) that read `opportunity_metrics`'s object, or names an existing grant. A gate nobody holds would hide Pipeline from the sales users too.

## Acceptance

- `pipeline_dashboard` and `nav_pipeline_dashboard` declare the same `requiredPermissions`, with a capability that the CRM sales set(s) able to read the dashboard's dataset actually grant.
- A plain member (no sales set): the CRM sidebar has no Pipeline entry, and a direct link to the dashboard gets `dashboard-access-denied`.
- A sales user: sees Pipeline and its tiles as today.
- Pins in the app's tests (`examples/app-crm/test/**`, beside the smoke test). Both rows are checked through the server's read gate, not a client guess.

## Reader who acts

The lane that owns `examples/app-crm` (triage names it; app lane). Size S.

## reach

Public door: CRM example → sidebar → Analytics → Pipeline, as any member without a sales permission set (the 18.3.0 RC walkthrough's member, #27377 W3-UX).

## Dedupe

No existing card asks for the CRM dashboard's audience gate. I read the #27491 ruling 6508997538 (it names this card as not yet filed) and the 100 most recent open `domain:ui` / app issues by title for `requiredPermissions`, `pipeline_dashboard` and `audience`.

Links back: #27491 (ruling 6508997538, item 5)
